data_fields.name: shake_jitter_interval_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: 16 (fix choice; donor gate is Timer and 5 = 0, no interval)

best_idea: After a heavy blast, offset the drawn camera by a random jitter whose size falls over a short window and is replaced each interval, so the shake dies out on its own while the follow position is never written.
decision_why: Keeps the decaying-jitter curve for heavy impacts on the world camera (row 10 hit impact); the donor's accumulated offset (never reset to base) and frame-gated cadence are fixed in the sketch. Pit camera is frozen, so the shake is off there.
acceptance: A client test after a heavy impact shows the drawn camera offset inside the amplitude curve (13 px at 0 ms falling to 1 px at 200 ms, times zoom/2, floor 1), exactly 0 by 250 ms, and the follow base identical to a run with shake off.
